title: GreenGateway policy evidence request
description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for a policy-evidence-request.v1 document: the inputs of one policy evidence package. The gateway's parser is authoritative and also enforces what this schema does not state: the suite is a complete policy-tests.v1 suite (see policy-tests.v1.schema.json) and every simulation case a policy-simulation.v1 case (see policy-simulation.v1.schema.json), with unique case ids; repeated member names are refused; and every limit is in bytes, not characters. Unknown members are refused everywhere.

version.description: The policy history version the package is about.

etag.description: The policy ETag of the document the caller reviewed. A stored document with any other ETag is refused with 409.

suite.description: A complete policy-tests.v1 suite, run against the published document.

simulation.description: Synthetic cases decided under the published document and the history version before it.

replay_job_id.description: A finished replay job of the caller's whose candidate is the published document.
